answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x at settlement peak and the security release cannot be reverted, so rollback is off the table. Circuit breaking risks dropping customer writes, which violates the objective. Cause is still ambiguous (release-induced write cost vs primary contention vs insufficient headroom), so I am verifying the two closest load/latency analogs before committing. Provisioning headroom is the intervention most aligned with keeping writes flowing under heavy settlement traffic; replica offload is the fallback if the archive shows primary read contention rather than write saturation. Guarded, limited scale because we get only one move at peak.
